fullDescription: Your private source material — resume text, LinkedIn, projects, skills, achievements, and notes. Resume generation draws only from what's here.

getStarted.heading: Get started
getStarted.body: Paste everything you have — resume text, LinkedIn profile, GitHub projects, work experience, achievements, skills, and notes. This becomes your single source of truth; nothing beyond what you write here is ever added on your behalf.
getStarted.placeholder: Paste your resume, LinkedIn text, projects, experience, skills, achievements, notes...

existing.heading: Your knowledge base
existing.body: Structured by AI from what you pasted in, and directly editable any time. Tailored resumes are generated only from what's written here — nothing is ever added that wasn't in your original text.
existing.showOriginal: Show original text you pasted in
existing.hideOriginal: Hide original text you pasted in

deleteDialog.title: Delete knowledge base
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes your career knowledge base. You'll need to paste your information again to rebuild it.
